How Pixhaus compares

Built on familiar ground, extended where the existing tools leave gaps.

vs Aseprite

The gold standard for pixel art editing. Pixhaus reads and writes its file format and matches its workflow. The differences are open source, working layer-group blend modes, first-class tilemaps, and AI verbs.

vs Pixelorama

An open-source Aseprite alternative. Pixhaus goes further with Aseprite file format compatibility, a real plugin system with custom UI and AI verbs, and a deeper tilemap layer model.

vs Photoshop

The broad canvas. Pixhaus is narrower by design: pixel art, animation, tilemaps. What it gives back: pixel-art-specific tools, indexed-color discipline, a tilemap layer type, and AI built for sprite workflows.
